system.describe.refusal: Static product metadata has no execution precondition; malformed input is covered separately.

system.result-file.success: Legacy-only sink switching is explicitly forbidden by P2 in agent sessions; core/c02-result-file.json covers legacy success.
system.result-file.no-op: Agent sessions reject all sink switches.
system.result-file.dry-run: P2 forbids sink switching in a session, including dry-run.

session.status.refusal: Status is available without a document or active request; invalid transport/params are separate cases.

session.cancel.refusal: M1 has no cooperative long operation. Cancelling a nonexistent request is a tested no-op, not an execution refusal.

session.release.refusal: M1 has no tokens; unknown IDs are reported not found without mutation. Token ownership/capacity arrives in later slices.

session.close.no-op: Successful close terminates its transport; there is no reusable already-closed session.
session.close.refusal: Dirty close refusal requires an editable dirty document in M2; M1 inspection is immutable and never dirty.
